residual_risks.statement: Mutable workspace hashes establish internal consistency, not producer identity, external attestation, Git index state or commit authority.
The environment profile is configuration evidence, not operating-system runtime isolation or a filesystem sandbox.
Node child_process can execute commands outside the environment-profile contract.
PowerShell and cmd.exe are not intercepted or restricted by an executable allowlist.
Arbitrary external executables can bypass profile validation.
A Parent Task permission override may broaden an Agent TOML sandbox.
Canonical-path and reparse-point checks reduce path escape risk but cannot eliminate filesystem TOCTOU races.
The exact-manifest scanner is not DLP or proof that all secrets, encrypted content, archives, polyglots, fragments or novel binary formats are absent.
Distinct session identifiers support auditability but are not cryptographic proof of clean-context isolation.
